active_field.reference: G_t = #26 whole-stone median on fixed common registered support
active_field.scale: S_t = 1.4826 * median(|Y_t(p)-G_t|) on the same fixed support

decisions.candidate: robust bright active field G_t + k*S_t
decisions.reason: The initial multiplicative threshold failed cross-vendor availability. Robust fixed-support contrast normalization restores all four stones at baseline and preserves cross-stone morphology rank under k=0.90/1.10.

Visible broad/fragmented evidence corresponds to the statistic; core-to-wide, threshold and fixed-to-dynamic cross-stone rank Spearman are all 1.0, while matched active-area frames can differ strongly in morphology.
Pooled baseline core-frame rank correlation with largest-component fraction is about -0.96, so it contributes little independent information.
Counts are dominated by many tiny marginal components and are less directly interpretable than area-weighted coherence.
It does not change cross-stone rank but individual support-motion disagreements can be material; fixed common support is the cleaner production contract.
Imposed radial boundaries can split otherwise connected whole-stone flashes and manufacture the morphology being measured.
The component family already separates matched-area morphology, and the second area-weighted component statistic is strongly redundant; no evidence justified adding entropy.
